The synergistic interaction with Sage Oil and Diazepam implies that Secobarbital may enhance the anticonvulsant effects of Diazepam, potentially increasing its efficacy in treating Status Epilepticus. The presence of a documented indication for Diazepam in this context supports the hypothesis that Secobarbital could contribute to the therapeutic effect in patients with Status Epilepticus. However, the strength of this relationship is limited by the low final score, suggesting that additional mechanistic evidence is needed to confirm the direct involvement of Secobarbital in the pathophysiology of Status Epilepticus.
